#N3on Just Surprised Former NBA Player Delonte West Who Has Been Through Some Hard Times With A BRAND NEW Maserati 🥹💯

N3on, whose real name is Mikyle Rafiq, is a popular livestreamer and internet personality known for his high-energy IRL streams, celebrity collaborations, and viral moments. Over the years, N3on has built a massive online following by bringing rappers, athletes, influencers, and other well-known personalities onto his streams. He’s also gained attention for helping people out on camera, including former NBA player Delonte West.

Delonte West is a former NBA guard who played eight seasons in the league after being selected in the first round of the 2004 NBA Draft. He suited up for teams including the Boston Celtics, Seattle SuperSonics, Cleveland Cavaliers, and Dallas Mavericks. West was known as a tough, versatile guard and notably spent multiple seasons alongside LeBron James in Cleveland.

N3on and Delonte West’s connection has continued to grow through their time together on stream. N3on has previously helped West with new equipment and an iPhone, and now he took things to another level by surprising him live on stream with a brand-new Maserati Levante. The moment quickly became another major chapter in their unlikely friendship, with N3on continuing to show support for the former NBA player.
